rule_events.recipe: card_paper + teleport + material accent
rule_events.policy: Confirmed visible placement; one event per batch, never on failed drag.

rule_events.recipe: card_paper; crystal only when a choice is revealed
rule_events.policy: Paper one-shot per actual card transition, rate limited on multi-draw.

rule_events.recipe: ui_confirm; power for a granted extra action
rule_events.policy: Turn cue only for local player. No sound for every ready flag update.

rule_events.recipe: resource_coins
rule_events.policy: Aggregate deltas once per turn/event; reverse or lower pitch for spend/drain, distinct from real-money purchases.

rule_events.recipe: body_hit, metal_hit or wood_hit according to victim
rule_events.policy: Impact once per visible hit, counterattack uses attacker cue once; cap simultaneous victims.

rule_events.recipe: heal; potion or mechanism overlay if physical
rule_events.policy: Only positive actual healing; suppress healed-zero/no-op and rot-blocked blooms.

rule_events.recipe: metal_hit + quiet power; teleport for an actual swap
rule_events.policy: Only when protection changes the result; no sound on passive adjacency alone.

rule_events.recipe: crystal + card_paper or teleport
rule_events.policy: Only information that client is allowed to know. Hidden actions cannot leak location or identity.

rule_events.recipe: power + identity accent
rule_events.policy: Play only activation/threshold change, not continuous derived recomputation.

rule_events.recipe: roots or magic_dark; charm_pipes for sleep
rule_events.policy: Apply once; no loop on disabled pieces; removal uses a soft heal/crystal tail.

rule_events.recipe: charm_pipes + card_paper; ui_confirm on local regained control
rule_events.policy: Distinguish control expiration with softer reversed/tail variant.

rule_events.recipe: wing_insect + roots; death + teleport; death only on exile
rule_events.policy: Replacement is one death plus one spawn; avoid playing a second generic kill.

rule_events.event: dig / tunnel / jump / hop / push / pull
rule_events.recipe: swamp_squelch or teleport + landing material
rule_events.policy: No loud takeoff for ordinary slide; collision impact only if a collision occurs.

rule_events.recipe: mechanism for a physical stance; teleport + identity for magical form
rule_events.policy: Aim is a ratchet/string creak, not a gunshot.

rule_events.recipe: death + payload cue (power/heal/explosion/teleport)
rule_events.policy: Payload at resolution, death once. Do not play an ordinary hostile hit on activation.

rule_events.recipe: steam + low magic_dark tail
rule_events.policy: Supported reusable rules, no live catalog bearer currently; one onset/expiry, no permanent hum required.

rule_events.recipe: power + resource_coins or magic_dark
rule_events.policy: Covers runtime damage/resources/resourceDrain enchantment types; expiration uses death tail.

rule_events.recipe: magic_bright or magic_dark / heal / resource_coins / steam
rule_events.policy: Only four supported spell effect names. Undefined spells receive ui_reject and no cast/impact.

rule_events.recipe: alert_bell then victory/defeat
rule_events.policy: Outcome once after authoritative result, cancel queued combat sound tails.

rule_events.event: resurrection to hand / evacuate to hand
rule_events.recipe: death reversed + card_paper + optional heal
rule_events.policy: Raise Undead returns one-health card to hand in current rules; do not play a board spawn until deployment.

ui.interaction: Button, keyboard activation, checkbox, tab, dropdown
ui.policy: Audible quiet pitched hover on target entry; firmer activation. No hover repeat while stationary; click takes precedence in the same frame.

ui.interaction: Focus, typing, caret, selection, password visibility
ui.policy: No keystroke chatter or sound exposing password length.

ui.recipe: ui_tap at release/detents; ui_confirm on saved
ui.policy: No continuous drag noise; use preview cue only if audio is enabled.

ui.interaction: Login, create account, change password, logout
ui.policy: Acknowledge server success or failure once.

ui.recipe: pitched/reversed card_paper for panels; quiet ui_tap for changed list offsets
ui.policy: Open/close and card inspection announce transitions. Redraws and scroll limits stay silent; cancel is not an error.

ui.interaction: New/edit/delete, search/filter, inspect, add/remove, drag/drop, unsaved prompt
ui.recipe: card_paper + ui_tap; ui_confirm on save; ui_reject invalid
ui.policy: Reorder/remove can use reversed paper, no separate recordings.

ui.interaction: Purchase, coin pack, claim deck, reveal, rarity
ui.policy: Only verified purchase completion. Rarity changes layering/timing, not a new master per rarity.

ui.recipe: ui_tap; alert_bell + ui_confirm when ready; ui_reject on failure
ui.policy: No looping search beep; ready cue must remain recognizable.

ui.interaction: Piece/card hover, inspect, select/deselect, action choice
ui.policy: No attack sound until accepted action resolves.

ui.interaction: Legal move/deploy, drag cancel, invalid target, power/sacrifice confirmation
ui.policy: Avoid button + generic attack + ability triple triggering.

ui.interaction: Hand fan, draw/discard, foresight choice, graveyard, raise undead
ui.policy: Draw/reveal should not leak concealed cards to another player.

ui.interaction: Start/end turn, command selection, timer 120/60/30s, result
ui.policy: Use existing clock-warning tracker; at most one warning per crossed threshold.

ui.recipe: card_paper + ui_tap; ui_confirm at completed objective
ui.policy: Narrator text is silent; no generated speech needed.

ui.interaction: Gate/cage, raft/boat/flood, fire/fuse, collapse/explosion, signal bell
ui.policy: Authored one-shot at visible story beat; no automatic keyword-triggered narration effects.

ui.interaction: Event list/create/join/ready/start/end, army setup, placement, orders/undo/exit
ui.policy: Strategic movement reuses foot_soft/foot_heavy; capture power; casualties death; awards resource_coins.

ui.interaction: Deadline, battle becomes available, eliminated, final winner
ui.policy: Only meaningful new state once; suppress repeated refresh notices.

ui.interaction: New/copy/save/delete cards/actions, filters, lists, asset pick, grants
ui.policy: All CRUD and confirmations reuse player UI vocabulary; no admin-only sound pack.

ui.recipe: one alert_bell or ui_reject; ui_confirm on recovered
ui.policy: Snapshot resync is silent: do not replay all old summons/damage/deaths.

ui.interaction: Menu/map/story environmental bed, idle and fidget
ui.policy: Current fidgets disabled. If enabled later, use sparse material/cloth/wing accents only for visible actor; do not add a sound every loop.
